caroline: Quick heads-up  went to Greenside Pharmacy for my 30-day refill of my specialty inhaler and they said they couldn't verify coverage with the PBM. They asked me to pay $420 cash. I had the insurer app + digital card. I'm out $420  what should I do?

nate (People Ops): Sorry that happened, @caroline. Short checklist: 1) get the pharmacy itemized receipt (must include prescription number, NDC or drug name, quantity, days supply, date, dispensing pharmacy NABP or NPI, and Rx price). 2) download the insurer's digital ID PDF (NB: pharmacy claims often need BIN/PCN/Group info). 3) submit an out-of-pocket pharmacy claim to the PBM and cc benefits@redwood.com.

caroline: The receipt just says "medication" and a total. They said their POS couldn't locate my BIN/PCN.

pbm-broker: Two parallel actions: A) ask the pharmacy to re-run eligibility and bill the PBM using the BIN/PCN on your digital ID (sometimes they need the card fields entered manually), B) if they insist you paid, submit a member pharmacy claim for reimbursement. Also check if the specialty med requires prior auth or specialty pharmacy routing  that can explain why POS fails.

pharmacy-bot: Digital ID + pharmacy fields for member 221100334: https://portal.insurer/ids/221100334.pdf  (Member ID: 221100334, Group: RW-00011, BIN: 610011, PCN: RWX2026, RxGrp: RWPHY) :card_file_box:

caroline: Ok I have the PDF now. The pharmacist said the POS returned "PBM not found" and they couldn't process electronically. They gave a receipt with only date and amount.

nate (People Ops): Ask the pharmacy for an "itemized pharmacy receipt" or a "pharmacy claim printout". If they re-run eligibility and it still fails, get the pharmacist's name and the store NCPDP/NPI. That info helps the PBM.

pbm-broker: If the drug is a specialty med, it may be managed through a carve-out specialty pharmacy (different PBM routing). I'll check broker-side whether this NDC should route to a specialty hub. If it is carve-out, member has to get it from the specialty vendor or we can request an exception.

caroline: If I pay now, how do I submit a claim? Is there a template?

nate (People Ops): Use the PBM claim submission form or email claims@pbm.example. Include the pharmacy itemized receipt, digital ID PDF, Rx label/photo (if available), prescriber name and contact, and a short cover note. Below is a quick email template you can copy.

```
To: claims@pbm.example
Subject: Pharmacy claim reimbursement  Member 221100334  Rx # 12345678  2026-10-02
Body:
Hello,
Please find attached the pharmacy receipt and digital ID for Member Caroline L (Member ID 221100334, Group RW-00011). Prescription: albuterol-sulfate inhaler (NDC 00000-0000-00), Rx# 12345678, Date filled: 2026-10-02, Pharmacy: Greenside Pharmacy (NCPDP: 9876543). I paid $420 out-of-pocket because the POS could not verify PBM coverage. Please advise on reimbursement and whether the claim can be reprocessed as in-network.
Attachments: itemized_receipt.pdf, digital_id.pdf, rx_photo.jpg
Thanks,
Caroline L
```

pbm-broker: Pro-tip: include the NDC and NCPDP; if the POS didn't capture the BIN/PCN, note the BIN/PCN from the digital card in the email body so the PBM can re-route. Also ask pharmacy to attempt a manual override re-bill with the BIN/PCN.

caroline: Sent to claims@pbm.example and cc'd benefits@redwood.com. Pharmacist said if it's a specialty-only channel they might not be able to dispense. What happens then?

pbm-broker: If it's specialty-managed, the retail pharmacy will either transfer or return the claim. We can coordinate with the specialty vendor for a one-time fill or direct you to the right speciality pharmacy. If they return the claim, keep the return note and the pharmacist's name; that helps with appeals.

nate (People Ops): Timeline expectations: PBM ack 3-10 business days, reimbursement/EOB 2-6 weeks. If claim stalls, benefits@redwood.com will escalate with broker and PBM. Keep photos of the Rx label and your payment method receipt.

caroline: Thanks all  cc'd benefits and attached the receipt + PDF + photo of the Rx label. Appreciate the help.

pharmacy-bot: If you need a physical insurance card mailed: portal > Account > Request ID Card. Some PBMs also provide a separate Rx ID card; check the PDF for RX fields.

pbm-broker: I'll open a broker-ticket and flag this as a potential routing/carve-out issue. I'll update here once I hear back from the PBM. :spiral_calendar:
